networks.name: openaward_passport
networks.description: A private student funding profile with an assistant that works for the student's privacy: it plans the least each award publisher needs to know, then has publishers check exactly the fields the student chose to share.
sample_queries: Which publishers are worth asking, and what is the least I need to share with each?
Follow the plan for the Federal Pell Grant.
Ask the Oregon Grant Rules Desk to check the 2027-28 grant with what I chose to share.
Why do my Pell and Oregon results differ?
Add the next steps from my results to my checklist.
Apply for the Pell Grant for me.

peer_policy.note: Calls only the publisher sites in allowed_peers, after the visitor agrees on a card for each one.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
